verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents one user-configurable mechanism that runs on its own: Decision Center policies set at the Sale checkpoint are applied automatically to every incoming order. Webhooks then push each guarantee decision to the merchant's store in real time. This is a narrow, fraud-policy form of background automation, not a general automation builder. Missing for 10: general-purpose automation or workflow configuration, scheduled or recurring jobs, agent-driven autonomous actions, depth of documentation on Decision Center policies, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: If Decision Center is enabled, policies for Sale events can be configured at the Sale checkpoint, and they will be applied to orders created via requests to this endpoint.
Signifyd can send a webhook to notify your online store every time a guarantee decision is made on a submitted order.
